description.en: Original0.8m sandstone teaching exposure with three cross-bed sets: physical inclined wedge laminae end against distinct set boundaries, with alternating dip directions and subtle real cut-face relief readable in gray. Not texture-only diagonal stripes, a uniformly rotated older cliff, or a precise paleocurrent/site/age reconstruction. Empty era/biome facets remain unspecified.
